🐾 Fishy’s Friends Rescue – YouTube Channel Description
Fishy’s Friends Rescue is a foster-based, 501(c)(3) nonprofit serving Comanche County, Oklahoma, and surrounding areas. Our mission is simple but urgent: to rescue, rehabilitate, and re home homeless and abandoned dogs while addressing the root causes of pet overpopulation through education and community outreach.
We are not a shelter—we are a network of everyday people opening their homes and hearts to dogs in need. From dumped litters to overlooked strays, we focus on the dogs who have nowhere else to go.
On this channel, you’ll find:
Foster journeys and training education
Education on responsible pet ownership and prevention
Community initiatives, events, and outreach efforts
The reality of rescue—both the wins and the hard days
Join us. Adopt. Foster. Donate.Volunteer.Educate.
